title: Quick-Fix Pungent American Yautia Fritters
description: These fritters use yautia, a Caribbean root vegetable, to create a tender and pungent American dish that's perfect for a quick fix.

ingredients.name: Shredded Cheese
ingredients.notes: Any type of shredded cheese works.

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: To add a touch of spice.

instructions: In a large bowl, combine yautia, infuse-oil, eggs, shredded cheese, flour, baking powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and buttermilk. Mix until well combined.
Add chopped scallions and mix well.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop mixture into balls.
Flatten each ball slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a large skillet or frying pan with about 1/2 inch of oil over medium-high heat until hot.
Carefully place fritters in the hot oil and fry for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped scallions if desired.
For an extra crispy coating, sprinkle fritters with paprika before serving.
If desired, serve with a side of your favorite dipping sauce.
Repeat the frying process with remaining mixture until all fritters are cooked.
Keep fritters warm in the oven at 200°F (90°C) until ready to serve.
